title: Node
explain: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime that lets you run JavaScript outside the browser, on your computer or server. It comes with built-in modules you can import using `require()` or `import` statements. Node.js is perfect for building command-line tools, servers, and backend applications.
exercise: Modify the code to read a file, convert its text to uppercase using `.toUpperCase()`, and write the result to a new file.
tip: A common mistake is forgetting to specify the encoding (like 'utf8') when reading files, which can return a Buffer object instead of a readable string.
